policies.sourceText: All courses for the minor must be completed for a letter grade of C or better or S. P/NC grades are not acceptable in courses taken for the minor.
All courses for the minor must be completed for a letter grade of C or better or S.
All students must complete a minimum of 8 upper division credits in 300-level or chemistry research courses in residency at Stony Brook in order to qualify for the minor.

notes.text: The minor requires 18-22 credits in total. An S grade is accepted in place of a letter grade. P/NC grades are not acceptable for courses taken for the minor.
